title: Felix and the Archive
author: Lior Kavanagh
blurb: Zephyrine Yarrow, the caretaker of Earth's abandoned seed vault, has spent fifteen years hauling cargo through contested orbits. But when a distress signal arrives in a language extinct for two centuries, he discovers that staying invisible was never really an option. To get through this, he must keep a lie alive that holds two fleets apart before the reactor finishes its countdown.
style: vivid, cinematic prose with tight pacing
